name: task-tracker
description: One task tracker for everything you have committed to, pulled from Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, Notion, ClickUp and meeting notes into a single TASKS.md: committed actions only, de-duplicated, with owner, source, raised and due dates. Morning brief, a tick-box dashboard whose changes you paste back, and paste-ready scheduled sweeps. Works in Claude Code and Claude Cowork. By Benjamin Vermeulen, @SIwithBen.
